AgentChat_Description: Embeds the Governor365 Copilot Studio agent in a canvas app.
ConnectionStatus_Description: Current connection status: connecting, connected, or error.
ContextJson_Description: Versioned JSON object describing the current canvas app context.
ContextVersion_Description: Increment this value when the app context changes.
LastActionJson_Description: Validated JSON payload for the latest canvas action.
LastActionName_Description: Name of the latest validated canvas action emitted by the agent.
Locale_Description: Web Chat locale such as en-US.
OnAgentAction_Description: Power Fx behavior invoked when the agent emits a validated canvas action.
OnConnectionStatusChanged_Description: Power Fx behavior invoked when the Direct Line connection state changes.
PromptText_Description: Bounded prompt sent by a deliberate canvas app interaction.
PromptVersion_Description: Increment this value to send the current prompt text once.
SsoClientId_Description: Application client ID for the PCF single-page application registration.
SsoLoginHint_Description: User principal name used to silently select the signed-in Power Apps account.
SsoRedirectUri_Description: Registered SPA redirect URI for this Canvas app.
SsoTenantId_Description: Microsoft Entra tenant ID used to acquire the token-exchange token.
TokenEndpoint_Description: Copilot Studio Mobile App channel token endpoint.
UserDisplayName_Description: Display name shown in Web Chat.
UserId_Description: Stable non-secret identifier for the signed-in user.
